Messages.Author: Matt Latham
Messages.Body:
I know that an Embrace banished to the Uncontrolled Region still counts as a
Vampire, but does the skill card on it count toward capacity... IE is it a 1
cap or a 2 cap for the purposes of influencing.

Matt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The cards on him are out of play as long as he is.
He's just a 1-cap.
See the RTR post linked as a reference to the "still counts as a vampire"
ruling from the errata/rulings page.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The cards on the banished vampire are out of play until the vampire returns to
the controlled area.



Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
> Matt Latham wrote:
>> I know that an Embrace banished to the Uncontrolled Region still counts as a
>> Vampire, but does the skill card on it count toward capacity... IE is it a 1
>> cap or a 2 cap for the purposes of influencing.

> LSJ wrote:
> The cards on the banished vampire are out of play until the vampire returns to
> the controlled area.

To clarify, since the Maser: Discipline card is out of play, it does not
count towards the capacity of the Embrace and it is considered a 1
capacity vampire while uncontrolled. However, if you have 2 blood on the
vampire when you bring into the Ready region, none of the blood will
fall off as it becomes a 2 capacity vampire at the time you bring it
out.

Regards,
Noal
